description: Returns a link to the DelegAIze page where the user connects Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP READ-ONLY. There the last 100 mails are clustered into recurring processes, 1-3 agents run live on them as drafts, and access is revoked or discarded right after. Use it when the user wants the check on their real mailbox but you have no mail tools, or prefers us to do the analysis. Explain that they must give consent on the page. Nothing happens until they open the link.

pc.description: Optional partner code from the user's link. Passed on to the sign-up/demo link.

ref.description: Optional person code from the link the user came with (e.g. th, km). Passed on to the sign-up/demo link.

variante.description: Campaign entry: backoffice (default), sap, maschinenbau, partner, verain (clubs), coachaize (studios), tekta (structures). sachverstaendige returns the trial case file link instead.
